summary: Vuzix Corp filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, announcing entry into an Open Market Sales Agreement with Jefferies LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering. The company may sell up to $100 million of common stock through Jefferies as sales agent under its existing Form S-3 registration statement. Jefferies receives a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds and will use commercially reasonable efforts to place shares based on company instructions. This is a routine capital-raising facility with no special-situation elements like control changes, strategic reviews, or restructuring.
